name: lv_image_cache_drop

provenance.source: Exact .139 LVGL image cache drop: src=0 clears the decoded-image cache (*0x200bd310) and image-header cache (*0x200bd314) via lv_cache_drop_all; recovered from 40+ firmware callers and the LRU-rb class vtable at 0x2ca168c4+28.

notes: Image-invalidation lever for redirected images: the cache is keyed by source path, so an already-decoded image is served before open() and must be dropped for a path redirect to take effect on the next redraw. Only unreferenced entries are freed; must run on the UI owner thread, never under the interrupt lock. Device probe pending.
